definition.note: Schoen's hexagonal H'-T family from the 1970 NASA report, exhibited by 3DXM as a morphing hexagonal family with its fundamental region marked.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
